versions.changelog:
- Initial release of cravego-promo-offer-angler skill.
- Generates safe, friendly & casual promo offer angles for CraveGo.ph, focused exclusively on new-user/signup promotions.
- Requires at least 5 unique angles centered on “₱ discount on first order”.
- Requires at least 5 unique, rotating angles with no fixed promo (e.g., waived delivery, bundle deals, signup points).
- Outputs suggestions in JSON format for use on FB, IG, or TikTok.
- Designed to avoid financial/legal claims and guarantees.
